display_name: Sheets Spreadsheets Values Batch Clear By Data Filter
description: sheets.spreadsheets.values.batchClearByDataFilter: POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchClearByDataFilter. Clears one or more ranges of values from a spreadsheet. For more information, see Read, write, and search metadata. The caller must specify the spreadsheet ID and one or more DataFilters. Ranges matching any of the specified data filters will be cleared. Only values are cleared -- all other properties of the cell (such as formatting, data validation, etc.) are kept. Body: vendor BatchClearValuesByDataFilterRequest JSON, checked against the pinned discovery schema. Runs as a background job; completion preserves the vendor response and names the selected account. key, access_token and oauth_token are refused: the connected account authenticates. Parameters use exact vendor names. See editors_api_coverage.md for scopes, bodies and lifecycle.
embedding_description: Use Sheets Spreadsheets Values Batch Clear By Data Filter to clears one or more ranges of values from a spreadsheet in Google Sheets, as the selected connected Google account (POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchClearByDataFilter). Send the vendor BatchClearValuesByDataFilterRequest body; it is checked against Google's schema. Returns Google's full response.
